scope: Sensitivity and derived decision conditions; no change to original source inputs, historical methods or baseline annual cube

timing_rules.linear: Progress x between each consecutive pair of anchors
timing_rules.earlier_arrival: Progress sqrt(x) between each consecutive pair of anchors
timing_rules.later_arrival: Progress x^2 between each consecutive pair of anchors
timing_rules.last_interval_early_plateau: Linear through 2030; traverse the last source-anchor increment in 2031-2034, then hold it in 2035

timing_rules_evidence: Illustrative monotone, anchor-preserving author scenarios, fixed before computing new outcomes; not four independently observed annual forecasts or calibrated probability bounds
source_total_system_paths: Unchanged at every year; changing the decomposed DC component changes the implied non-DC background and does not certify that background as an independently forecast path
base_year_rule: Keep the existing zero incremental 2025 comparison base; this sensitivity does not validate the base-year inclusion assumption
candidate_temporal_shapes: Three national paths times three extensions; capture, fixed peak mapping and allocation modify amplitude, not the normalized temporal shape
response_stock_comparison: Compare the original per-load scaled association with H^S=min(H^O, per-load scaled H^S) at fixed source background. The latter retains a fixed associated-response budget; neither identifies actual DC-induced response.
resource_frontier: At zero associated response, interpolate algebraically between matched anticipated and prospective native contributions R(u)=R_A+u(R_P-R_A), 0<=u<=1. Required u is the greatest annual -B_A/(R_P-R_A), respecting infeasible and zero-u cases. This is a conditional contribution threshold, not a completion probability or a build forecast.
